significance: The Divya Desam of Thirukandiyur near Thiruvaiyaru, praised by Thirumangai Alvar and one of the few temples housing images of Vishnu, Shiva and Brahma in one premises.
story: Shiva, burdened by the sin of severing Brahma's fifth head, is said to have been freed of it after worshipping Vishnu and bathing in the temple tank here.
